# Awesome AI Model Showcases

**Find an animation idea. Read the original prompt. Follow the source.**

Awesome AI Model Showcases collects real public AI model GIF and animation cases: original authors, original media, public prompts, sources, and production pipelines. It is organized by model family (GPT Image is one subsection), not this repository's original playbook showcase.

## What can I do with this catalog?

1. **Open a case.** Start with the gallery or a preview above.
2. **Read the source and prompt.** `prompt.md` contains published wording, a partial prompt when that is all the source provides, or an explicit unpublished marker. An existing prompt file does not mean a full prompt is available.
3. **Check the pipeline and rights.** Native animation, sprite-sheet assembly, and post-processing are different workflows. Reproduction can vary with model access and settings.

No account, API key, or installation is required to browse. If this saves you a search, **star the repository to keep it handy**. To help it grow, contribute an original source or correct an attribution.

<a id="local-setup"></a>
## How do I browse locally?

Only Python 3 is needed to serve the static gallery. Browsing does not generate images or call the Images API.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-ai-model-showcases.git
cd awesome-ai-model-showcases
python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory docs
```

Open **[http://localhost:8000/?lang=en](http://localhost:8000/?lang=en)**. Switch to `?lang=zh` for Chinese.

<details>
<summary><strong>For contributors: structure and validation</strong></summary>

```text
docs/cases/<id>/          Original media, prompt.md, post.md, attribution
docs/data/               Generated catalog and local-media manifest
playbooks/research/      Source inventories and evidence
playbooks/community-cases.md  Complete evidence index
tools/templates/         English and Chinese README source templates
tools/                   Generators, media probes, and validators
```

The site uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on GitHub Pages. Python + Pillow validate images; `ffprobe` checks MP4 streams when installed, with an ISO-BMFF fallback locally. CI installs ffmpeg.

```bash
python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python3 tools/write_community_catalog.py
# Stage intentional generated changes before the freshness check.
git add README.md README.zh-CN.md playbooks/community-cases.md docs/data/community-cases.json docs/data/cases.js llms.txt docs/llms.txt docs/github-about.json
python3 tools/verify.py
```

Edit source inventories and templates, not generated README/catalog outputs. See the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full workflow.

</details>

<a id="contribute"></a>
## How do I submit a case?

**[Open the case submission form](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-ai-model-showcases/issues/new?template=case-submission.yml)**. No coding required: share the original author, source URL, all media links, published prompt or “unpublished,” and model/pipeline evidence.

Prefer a PR? Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Small corrections to attribution, broken links, prompt wording, or English/Chinese explanations are useful too. Every featured creator is credited in the case archive.

<a id="faq"></a>
## What is this repository?

A source-first library of AI model GIF/animation showcases, organized by model family. **GPT Image 2.6** is one populated subsection; Claude, Gemini, GPT Sol/Astra, Grok, Qwen, and DeepSeek sections are reserved for sourced cases. Each record keeps authorship, source links, local media where retrieved, prompt availability, model evidence, pipeline, and verification status together. Model names from sources (for example `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`) are preserved as claims, not independent verification.

## What can this repository not do?

- Generate images or provide an Images API application.
- Certify model origin or claim exhaustive web coverage. Author claim ≠ official verification; officially verified 2.6 game outputs: **0**.
- Treat an X “GIF” label as proof of GIF format. Many archived attachments are MP4, with no completed visual review or reproduction claim.
- Treat remakes, SVG concept art, or rewritten prompts as community originals. [Idea and popular-remake appendices](https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-ai-model-showcases/ideas.html) and six local seed GIFs stay separate from the main count.

## What are the license boundaries?

[MIT](LICENSE) covers source code and original project documentation. It does **not** automatically license third-party media, prompts, trademarks, or likenesses. Archived third-party files remain **license unknown** unless a grant is documented. Public availability is not author permission or CC0.

Read [MEDIA_RIGHTS.md](MEDIA_RIGHTS.md) before reuse. Rights holders can [open an issue](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-ai-model-showcases/issues/new) with the affected case URL to request attribution changes or removal.

## Which languages are maintained?

**English and 简体中文** share one inventory and the same case counts. Original quotes and prompts stay in their source language. The web catalog supports `?lang=en` / `?lang=zh`; idea/popular-remake appendices are Chinese-first, not a second synchronized catalog. No other README language editions are maintained.
